title: Sugar Paws | Benchmark Management Vacation Rental
meta_description: Sugar Paws is a 3.00 bedroom, 3.50 bathroom vacation rental.
description_expanded: Sugar Paws Seagrove Beach Home | Dog Friendly | 3BR / 3.5BA | Walk to BeachSugar Paws is a spacious dog-friendly 3-bedroom, 3.5-bath beach home located in the Village of Sugar Beach in the heart of Seagrove Beach along Scenic 30A. Located just across 30A from the Gulf of Mexico, this home places you only about 200 yards from the beautiful sugar white sands of South Walton. With public beach access directly across the street, beach days are always within easy reach, and beach chairs with an umbrella are provided for you to take along.This two-story home features wrap-around decks on multiple levels where you can enjoy the coastal breeze throughout the day. A third level deck provides a great spot to take in the sun or catch a sunset. The second floor deck includes an outdoor dining table, making it a great place to enjoy a meal outside. After returning from the beach, the outdoor shower makes it easy to rinse off before heading back inside.Sugar Paws is especially well suited for multiple families traveling together thanks to its two kitchens and washer and dryer on both floors. The first floor features two bedrooms, two bathrooms, a fully stocked kitchen, living and dining area, and a stackable washer and dryer. The second floor includes another full kitchen with stainless steel appliances, a gas stove, breakfast bar, living room, dining area with seating for six, and the master bedroom suite with a private bathroom. A half bath is located off the living area, along with a full-size washer and dryer.Separate first and second floor entrances offer additional convenience and privacy for larger groups. With a king bed in the upstairs master suite, three queen beds, and a sofa sleeper upstairs, the home comfortably accommodates up to 10 guests. Located between Seaside and Rosemary Beach, the home is also within walking distance of Café 30-A, Angelina’s, and several other restaurants and local shops.Beach Access:Head west on Sugar Sand Lane and turn left on Somerset Bridge. Directly across 30A at the Tom Thumb is your beach access.Distance: .1 mile | Time: 2 minutes walkingVillage of Sugar Beach:Village of Sugar Beach is in the heart of Seagrove and just short walk across 30A to the sugar sand beaches. This community has no thru streets so there is minimal traffic making it safe for the kids. There is a community pool for the entire family to enjoy. Local shops and favorite restaurants are within walking distance. Minutes away is Deer Lake State Park, offering miles of biking trails. Seaside is only a 1 ½ miles away where you can enjoy events throughout the year.Nearby Attractions:Enjoy the best of 30A with Brunos Pizza, Greenway Station, Café 30-A, Seagrove Market, Surfing Deer, Perfect Pig, The Big Chill, and Old Florida Fish House. Explore Seaside and WaterColor for boutique shopping, dining, and coastal charm just minutes away.Exclusive Xplorie Guest Perks!Your stay at Sugar Paws comes with Xplorie’s best activities! One ticket per day, per activity (over $800 in nightly value). Tee off at Emerald Bay or Regatta Bay, zip through Baytowne Adventure Zone, and sail on the Sea Blaster Dolphin Cruise. Enjoy Big Kahuna’s Water Park, Black Light Mini Golf, and scenic bike rides with complimentary rentals. Explore 30A with ease and adventure.Other Things to Note:* Saturday to Saturday rental in season.* Parking for 4 cars.* NO Smoking Property – inside the house or anywhere on the property.* Dog Friendly: If bringing a pet, an additional non-refundable pet fee will be added to your booking. Please contact us if you are bringing a dog. A maximum of 2 dogs is allowed, with no size restrictions. Please see our rental policies for further details.Disclaimer:Please note that this property has a Ring camera located in an exterior common area. This device is used for exterior monitoring only and is permitted under Florida law.An initial starter kit of amenities are provided for all guests. For the kitchen this includes: 1 roll of paper towels, 1 dish sponge, 1 dish soap, 2 dishwasher pods, and 1 liner for each trashcan. For each bathroom it includes: 1 roll of toilet paper, 1 set of soap/body wash/shampoo/conditioner/lotion. For towels you will receive: 1 body towel/1 washcloth per guest and 2 hand towels per bathroom, plus 2 washing machine pods.
